construction_notes.text: Off-site below-market units in the Gatekeeper application for the office project at 2300 Broadway. City calls it 609 Price Street; county parcel data shows 609 Price Ave.

MidPen board states Tishman Speyer will provide the site and predevelopment funds, described as more than double what would be due under the City's Affordable Housing Ordinance; the site will be dedicated for 100% affordable housing.
The 2021 MidPen board shows 83 units; the city project list shows 98 units (38 very low, 58 low, 2 property management).
